title: Discovering Biases in Information Retrieval Models Using Relevance Thesaurus as Global Explanation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing global explanations via a constructed relevance thesaurus and performing counterfactual substitution of 29 different car brand names into otherwise identical document contexts to measure differences in neural ranking model scores.

Using a relevance thesaurus to compute representation scores for the query term 'when' against various specific years, and validating the findings by substituting different years into a fixed document context to measure changes in retrieval scores.
